initiative: QR wayfinding, RFID and content-led website
what_happened: A few wayfinding screens carry a QR code that opens a guided mobile experience. RFID is being rolled out so staff can locate merchandise. The website is content-led without e-commerce, and the stack is built on Shopify. The store is meant as a test lab for Paris.
physical_digital_bridge: QR code to a guided mobile experience
results_and_next_move: The page says it is unclear how much of the omnichannel vision is live.

what_happened: Champagne bar Salon Vert, a cafe in the Playroom and the restaurant Maison Passerelle (opened April 2025) are meant to make visitors linger.
